mapper.select: SELECT file_id,subbarcode,client,Ackerman_num,test_item,Overall_quality,HE_Dyeing,Seen_microscopically,TPS,CPS,reporter,reviewers,Tumor_cel_content,Tumor_cell_count,Detection_method,Detect_antibody,loaded_date,checked_by,checked_date FROM omics.pdinfo_file WHERE file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM omics.data_file_status WHERE subbarcode=#{subbarcode} and analysis_date=#{analysis_date} and product_name=#{product_name} and file_type="PDINFO" and status="Loaded")
